name: Cockroach!
storyline:
Your Roach Has Arrived!

Cockroach! is an idle desktop game where you can enjoy the following features:

Cockroaches crawling across your desktop

Satisfying gooey sound effects when you click them

Multiple modes: occasional appearance, always-on mode, and the crazy cockroach swarm

Irresistible collectible element: the Legendary Golden Roach!

Thrilling Challenge Mode

Achievements

Buy a copy for your friend, too!
summary: A cockroach crawling around on your computer desktop — and it even bursts with goo when clicked!
